1840company-1840-company:lever:e27abb25-.title: Prior Authorization Specialist
1840company-1840-company:lever:e27abb25-.description: We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Prior Authorization Specialist to manage the full lifecycle of prior authorizations (PAs) for medical services. The ideal candidate will be responsible for timely submission, meticulous follow-up, and effective resolution of all prior authorization requests and subsequent appeals. This role is critical in ensuring patients receive necessary services without delay and in maximizing reimbursement for the practice.
responsibilities: The Prior Authorization Specialist will be responsible for the following core duties:
Prior Authorization Submission and Monitoring:
Monitor the Prior Authorization queue and manage an organized list of outstanding and in-progress PAs
Review patient and service data provided by the biller/clinical team for completeness and accuracy
Submit new prior authorizations to the correct insurance company and plan efficiently via the required method, including insurance portals, fax, or telephone
Status Follow-Up:
Proactively and consistently call insurance companies to check on the status of submitted prior authorizations to prevent processing delays
Document all communication and status updates clearly and promptly in the patient management system
Denial Management and Appeals:
Identify, prepare, and submit prior authorization denial appeals in a timely manner, gathering all necessary clinical and administrative documentation
Track the status of all submitted appeals through resolution
System and Documentation Updates:
Monitor the designated fax inbox or electronic queue for prior authorization approvals, denials, and requests for additional information
Promptly update the patient management system with the final PA status, authorization number, and expiration date upon receipt of approval
qualifications: Exceptional Attention to Detail: Crucial for accurately submitting data and preparing appeals.
Strong Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills for professional interaction with insurance representatives and clinical staff
English Speaking: Fluency in English is required to effectively communicate with insurance representatives and team members.
Organizational and Time Management Skills: Ability to prioritize a high volume of PA requests and follow-up tasks under deadlines
Problem-Solving: Resourcefulness in troubleshooting issues with insurance company portals or processes.
Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively with billing and clinical teams to achieve patient care goals.

foundersfactory-founders-factory:ashbyhq.title: Co-Found with Founders Factory - Healthcare Studio
foundersfactory-founders-factory:ashbyhq.description: Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Headquartered in London and operating globally, Founders Factory backs visionary founders with capital, dedicated support from a team of expert operators, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry leading corporate partners. Since 2015, FF has backed 450+ portfolio companies helping them to secure over 500 enterprise pilots with blue chip corporate partners such as Aviva, Northwestern Medicine, Johnson & Johnson Innovation, and HSBC. Our Studio partners with entrepreneurs at day one, developing new ideas, technologies and business models into high growth companies. We have created the fastest way to build a successful startup. We specialise in building founding teams, developing disruptive concepts, finding your first customer, and raising your first round. We know that starting and growing a business is hard so we’ve designed the people, processes, and platform to remove as much friction as possible. The Opportunity: Health systems globally are burdened by capacity constraints, rising chronic disease, aging populations, and escalating operational costs. Care delivery models built around physical hospitals are increasingly unsustainable. Advances in connected devices, remote diagnostics, and AI-enabled monitoring now make it possible to safely move large parts of care beyond hospital walls while improving outcomes and patient experience. The big promise of technology in this space is to enable continuous, proactive, and lower cost care particularly across long-term condition management or home-based / community care while allowing scarce clinical resources to focus where they matter most. We are looking for exceptional entrepreneurs passionate about building the future of healthcare delivery. Whether you’re a healthtech founder post-exit looking for your next venture, an operator who’s scaled a business from the inside and is ready to build your own, or a researcher aiming to commercialise your work, Founders Factory is the world's best cofounder. Our areas of focus: - Connected Skilled Nursing Facilities OS - Post-Discharge Recovery Intelligence - Smart Hospital Asset Intelligence Layer - Clinical Coding Revenue Intelligence - Hospital Discharge Readiness Engine - Digital Biomarkers for Paediatric Neurodivergence - Cognitive Decline Early Detection + Caregiver Platform - Rapid Deploy Clinical Infrastructure What’s in it for me? - Co-found a company with Founders Factory’s team of IPO-exited founders and experienced operators - A validated problem space and early venture thesis - Access to a team of senior operators across product, engineering, data and growth. - Support from a Venture Builder, someone who can help build and validate quickly - Unlock pre-seed investment of €275k spin out capital - Join our 6-month venture build and acceleration programme - Access to the Founders Factory ecosystem, network and investors - Collaborate with industry-leading corporates, including healthcare system partners

jobgether-jobgether:lever:18b8be9f-a02c-.title: Technical Writer - PostgreSQL
jobgether-jobgether:lever:18b8be9f-a02c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Writer - PostgreSQL based in Portugal. This is an opportunity to join a distributed open-source software team focused on PostgreSQL and related database technologies. You’ll own the creation of clear, accurate, and user-oriented technical documentation across the product lifecycle. Working closely with engineers, product managers, QA, and fellow technical writers, you’ll turn complex technical concepts into practical resources for diverse audiences. The role combines technical writing, documentation strategy, developer tooling, and hands-on exploration of database systems. You’ll work in a docs-as-code environment and use modern AI tools to improve the speed and quality of your work. With a high degree of autonomy, flexible working hours, and a global team, this role is ideal for someone who enjoys both deep technical work and collaborative open-source environments. Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including installation and configuration guides, troubleshooting resources, how-to articles, user manuals, man pages, help prompts, and release documentation. Collaborate closely with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, developers, QA specialists, and other technical writers to produce accurate, timely, and high-quality documentation. Translate complex PostgreSQL and database concepts into clear, accessible content for users with different levels of technical expertise. Use Markdown, text, images, diagrams, and other formats to create engaging and effective documentation. Work within a docs-as-code methodology, maintaining documentation through version-controlled workflows and contributing to scalable documentation practices. Leverage AI-powered tools to draft, refine, structure, format, and improve technical content while maintaining accuracy and quality. Participate actively in team ceremonies, technical discussions, planning sessions, and other collaborative activities. Contribute to the broader documentation strategy and continuously improve writing standards, workflows, and processes. Engage with open-source communities through forums, mailing lists, and other communication channels, sharing knowledge and gathering technical insights. Research new technologies and contribute to upstream documentation, technical blog content, or other knowledge-sharing initiatives when appropriate. Help develop and maintain automated documentation testing, validation processes, and CI/CD workflows where applicable. Requirements: 3+ years of professional experience as a Technical Writer, with a proven ability to produce precise, high-quality technical documentation. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical subjects clearly and effectively. Experience documenting complex software systems and producing user-oriented documentation for technical audiences. Strong familiarity with markup languages, particularly Markdown. Hands-on experience installing and configuring database server software on Linux. Practical experience with docs-as-code methodologies and tools such as Git, Jenkins, Markdown, HTML, and/or JavaScript. Experience using AI tools to support technical documentation workflows. Comfortable working with the Linux command line and developer tools such as Git, GCC, and GDB. Understanding of distributed systems and/or database server development. Ability to work independently and manage priorities effectively within a globally distributed organization. Strong collaboration skills and experience communicating through tools such as Slack, Jira, Notion, Zoom, mailing lists, and community forums. Demonstrated ability to learn quickly, solve problems independently, and contribute positively as part of a distributed team. A developer or DevOps background is highly valued. Experience contributing to PostgreSQL or other open-sour

jobgether-jobgether:lever:f4b91883-98a8-.title: Azure Data Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:f4b91883-98a8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Azure Data Engineer based in Netherlands. This role offers the opportunity to strengthen cybersecurity operations by engineering reliable, scalable security data pipelines across cloud and on-premises environments. You will work with high volumes of security telemetry and help ensure critical data is available for threat detection, incident response, compliance, and cyber risk visibility. The position combines hands-on data engineering with cybersecurity, cloud technologies, automation, and data quality management. You’ll collaborate with application, infrastructure, security, governance, and vendor teams to onboard and optimize diverse data sources. The role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys troubleshooting complex ingestion challenges and improving system reliability and efficiency. You’ll operate in a highly regulated financial services environment where data integrity, security, and operational excellence are essential. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on the organization’s ability to detect, investigate, and respond to cyber threats. Design, build, and maintain scalable security data ingestion pipelines for SIEM and cloud data platforms, including Azure Data Explorer and Log Analytics. Parse, normalize, transform, enrich, and validate structured and unstructured security telemetry using regex, JSON parsing, schema mapping, and other data-processing techniques. Partner with application owners, infrastructure and cloud teams, vendors, security stakeholders, and other internal groups to onboard new log sources and validate end-to-end data flows. Ensure the integrity, completeness, timeliness, and quality of security telemetry used for monitoring, detection, incident response, reporting, and risk management. Align security data with established schemas, naming conventions, governance standards, and organizational requirements to support downstream analytics and automation. Troubleshoot ingestion, parsing, transformation, schema, and data-quality issues across diverse platforms and environments. Maintain clear documentation covering log onboarding procedures, source requirements, data mappings, pipeline configurations, and operational support processes. Collaborate with detection engineering and security operations teams to ensure telemetry supports investigation, threat detection, response, and cyber risk use cases. Conduct telemetry gap analyses, identify missing or incomplete data sources, and recommend priorities for improving security coverage. Support logging practices that meet regulatory, audit, compliance, retention, and data-integrity requirements. Improve ingestion frameworks, automation, and onboarding processes to increase scalability, repeatability, reliability, and cost efficiency. Support infrastructure-as-code, scripting, and automation initiatives that streamline deployment and ongoing pipeline maintenance. Monitor pipeline performance and work with stakeholders to optimize ingestion reliability, throughput, and operational costs. Stay current with emerging cybersecurity telemetry formats, logging standards, data engineering practices, and cloud security data-platform capabilities. Requirements: 3+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, data engineering, log management, security operations, or a related technology discipline. Hands-on experience onboarding, managing, and validating log sources within SIEM, cloud data platforms, or security analytics environments. Strong understanding of data parsing, normalization, transformation, and validation, including experience with regex, JSON, XML, CSV, and both structured and unstructured data. Familiarity with security telemetry from network, endpoint, identity, application, cloud, and infrastructure environments. Experience working with cloud platforms and associated logging, monitoring, and analytics servic

ryzlabs-ryzlabs:lever:f2afd25b-9eb2-4dd0.title: Staff/Senior Product Designer
ryzlabs-ryzlabs:lever:f2afd25b-9eb2-4dd0.description: RyzLabs is looking for a highly skilled Staff Product Designer to collaborate with a client who is building an AI-powered platform that helps heavy civil contractors analyze massive bid packages and make faster, more accurate estimates. What We’re Looking For: Required - A portfolio of shipped product design for complex, data-heavy tools — real products, real users - Systems thinker — you design components and patterns, not one-off screens - High ownership, speed, and comfort with ambiguity; you set your own bar - Strong written and verbal English; clear async communication Nice to have - You can build what you design — front-end skills (React/Tailwind) are a big plus - B2B SaaS, construction, or other industrial software. What we expect day to day: - You get problems, not tickets. There’s no PM. Dig into the product, talk to users, explore options, come back with a spec engineers can build from. - You live in Linear with the engineers. ~3–4 engineers to one designer. Specs, explorations, and decisions live in Linear, attached to the work. Daily standup; you show work-in-progress constantly, not big reveals. - You spend real time with customers. Customer calls and onboarding sessions weekly. Watch estimators actually use the product. Design decisions here are defended with “I watched an estimator do X” — not taste alone. - You work in the open and take feedback straight. We are direct. You ship progress to the team channel, present at reviews, and get honest feedback — including from the founder. We argue about the work, decide fast, and move. - You use AI aggressively. Everyone here uses AI daily for research, writing, analysis, and building. Same bar for design. About RYZ Labs: RYZ Labs is a startup studio built in 2021 by two lifelong entrepreneurs. The founders of RYZ have worked at some of the world's largest tech companies and most iconic consumer brands. They have lived and worked in Argentina for many years and have decades of experience in Latam. What brought them together is the passion for the early phases of company creation and the idea of attracting the brightest talents in order to build industry-defining companies in a post-pandemic world. Our teams are remote and distributed throughout the US and Latam. They use the latest cutting-edge technologies in cloud computing to create applications that are scalable and resilient. We aim to provide diverse product solutions for different industries, planning to build a large number of startups in the upcoming years. At RYZ, you will find yourself working with autonomy and efficiency, owning every step of your development. We provide an environment of opportunities, learning, growth, expansion, and challenging projects. You will deepen your experience while sharing and learning from a team of great professionals and specialists.
